description.value: Mia Pizza is a pizza restaurant located in Thornhill, the community just south of Terrace on the Old Lakelse Lake Drive corridor. It sits along a route cyclists travelling the Skeena Valley or heading toward Lakelse Lake Provincial Park may pass through. As a local pizza spot in a small community with limited dining options, it could serve as a useful resupply or meal stop for touring riders in the area.
